import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import zlib from "node:zlib";
const root=process.cwd();
const files=JSON.parse(zlib.gunzipSync(Buffer.from("","base64")).toString("utf8"));
for(const [rel,body] of Object.entries(files)){const dest=path.join(root,rel);fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(dest,body,"utf8");}
const read=p=>fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,p),"utf8");
const write=(p,s)=>fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root,p),s,"utf8");
let engine=read("src/recovery/engine.js");
if(!engine.includes("./advanced-recovery.js")) engine=engine.replace('import { actionAllowed } from "./compliance.js";','import { actionAllowed } from "./compliance.js";\nimport { advancedPlaybookFor } from "./advanced-recovery.js";');
const oldPlaybook='    const playbook = playbookFor(storedEvent.type, this.tenant.playbooks || {});';
const newPlaybook=`    const tenantOverride = this.tenant.playbooks?.[storedEvent.type];\n    const intelligentPlaybook = tenantOverride ? null : advancedPlaybookFor({\n      type: storedEvent.type,\n      event: storedEvent,\n      contact,\n      tenant: this.tenant,\n      now: new Date(storedEvent.occurredAt),\n    });\n    const playbook = tenantOverride || intelligentPlaybook || playbookFor(storedEvent.type, this.tenant.playbooks || {});`;
if(engine.includes(oldPlaybook)) engine=engine.replace(oldPlaybook,newPlaybook);
if(!engine.includes("advancedPlaybookFor")) throw new Error("v2.2 engine patch failed");
write("src/recovery/engine.js",engine);
let server=read("server.js");
if(!server.includes('./src/recovery/opportunity-priority.js')) server=server.replace('import { radarProof } from "./src/recovery/radarproof.js";','import { radarProof } from "./src/recovery/radarproof.js";\nimport { prioritizeOpportunities } from "./src/recovery/opportunity-priority.js";');
if(!server.includes('app.get("/api/v1/action-queue"')){const marker='app.get("/api/v1/radarproof", async (req, res) => {';if(!server.includes(marker)) throw new Error("v2.2 server insertion point missing");const route=`app.get("/api/v1/action-queue", requireAdmin, requireTenant, async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const snapshot = await recoveryStore.snapshot();\n    const tenantId = req.bookedRadarTenant.tenantId;\n    const opportunities = Object.values(snapshot.opportunities || {}).filter((x) => x.tenantId === tenantId);\n    const actions = Object.values(snapshot.actions || {}).filter((x) => x.tenantId === tenantId);\n    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(Number(req.query.limit || 25), 1), 100);\n    return res.json({ ok: true, tenantId, queue: prioritizeOpportunities({ opportunities, actions }).slice(0, limit) });\n  } catch (error) {\n    return res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: "action_queue_failed" });\n  }\n});\n\n`;server=server.replace(marker,route+marker);}
server=server.replaceAll("BookedRadar Platform v2.0","BookedRadar Platform v2.2").replace('version: "2.0.0"','version: "2.2.0"');
if(!server.includes('version: "2.2.0"')) throw new Error("v2.2 server version patch failed");
write("server.js",server);
console.log(JSON.stringify({event:"bookedradar.preload",version:"2.2.0",files:Object.keys(files).length}));
